props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Neither checked nor unchecked: a parent box whose children are mixed. A press clears it and toggles the box, as the browser does; a controlled `indeterminate` that stays true is set again.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Focusable and announced, but a press doesn't change it (`readonly` has no effect on a native checkbox).

props.name: name
props.description: With a name (or inside a named FieldRoot), the box submits `value` (default "on") with its form while checked.

props.name: value
props.description: Inside a CheckboxGroup, also the value the group's list holds while the box is checked.

props.name: parent
props.description: Inside a CheckboxGroup with `allValues`: the box that checks or clears them all, mixed while some are checked.

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Present once the field's value has changed.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the part is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field has a value.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the field has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Present once the field has been focused and left.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is valid.

parts.name: CheckboxIndicator
parts.description: A mark beside the box, always in the document: place it in CheckboxRoot, where it is the box's next sibling, and show it with `input:checked + *` and `input:indeterminate + *`. Hidden from assistive technology, which hears the box's own state.
